title: Spike: pin down verify-trust's exact interop surface
description: Read verify-trust, trql-client and vgi-core in ~/GIT/OpenVTC_* and write docs/trqp-interop.md answering: (1) HTTPS request/response wire format — plain TRQP POST /authorization or a Trust Task envelope (trusttasks.org/spec/registry/authorization/0.1)? (2) DID-document service entry format that ServiceCapabilities::from_document accepts for an HTTPS TRQP binding. (3) How the signer DID is written in the committer header, and whether a git-vouch user can produce it with plain git config. (4) Whether did:key resolves in its resolver. (5) Key types accepted: ssh-ed25519 only, or also sk-ssh-ed25519 / P-256? (6) Action string(s) used for commit/tag signing (e.g. git.commit.sign) and resource grammar. Every answer cited file:line.
acceptance_criteria: docs/trqp-interop.md exists with all six answers cited to source; any blocker to interop (e.g. Trust-Task-only HTTPS, no did:key resolution) stated plainly.
